title: BanMessagePurgeEvent
description: BAN_MESSAGE_PURGE bus event (discordy.guild.v1, routed by guild_id). A moderator banned a user with delete_message_seconds > 0 (PUT /guilds/{id}/bans/{uid}). The messages service deletes every message the user authored in the listed channels at or after since_ms (storage, search index, attachments, reactions, pins) and emits MESSAGE_DELETE_BULK per channel. The gateway ignores it and never dispatches it to clients. Replays are harmless: deleting already deleted messages is a no-op.

user_id.description: The banned user whose messages are purged.

channel_ids.description: The guild's text-capable channels and threads at ban time.

since_ms.description: Unix milliseconds: messages created at or after this instant are deleted (ban time minus delete_message_seconds).
